learning_outcomes.text: Students will find their own way to learn, study and use English both in meaningful personal contexts as well as in academic / working life situations.
Students will develop their English skills towards autonomous and spontaneous language use.
Students manage their own learning process by analysing their own identity as an English learner and their learning needs.
Students manage their own learning process by setting personalised learning goals.
Students manage their own learning process by choosing their approach to learning.
Students manage their own learning process by making a concrete learning plan and carrying it out.
Students manage their own learning process by reflecting on their learning process and results.

syllabus_topics: Language learner history and its effects on one's English learner identity
Ways of reflecting on one's own learning, such as a learning diary
Using and developing English together with other students
Skills for learning and studying English, depending on the particular needs of the students: listening, reading, speaking, writing.
